reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I placed one Bomb on Shrinker Beetle with Bag of Tricks, detonated it with Quick Fuse, hit Shrinker Beetle with Kaboom!, then played Duck and Cover.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered leaving the Bomb undetonated by skipping Quick Fuse, preserving it instead of taking its 5 damage now.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up keeping the Bomb on Shrinker Beetle for a later detonation and spent 2 energy for 5 Block and 7 immediate damage.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. With enough energy to play both costed cards and both zero-cost cards, a different telegraphed intent would not have changed this line.
